description: This source file implements the DataCapture plugin class in C++, which manages audio capturing sessions, handles IARM events related to audio clips, interacts with sockets and URL uploads, and exposes JSON-RPC methods for enabling audio capture and retrieving audio clips within a larger plugin architecture.

classes.name: DataCapture
classes.description: Main plugin class managing audio capture sessions, IARM events, socket communication, and JSON-RPC method handlers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM connections.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin and releases IARM resources.

methods.name: enableAudioCapture
methods.description: Starts or stops audio capturing based on provided buffer duration.

methods.name: getAudioClip
methods.description: Requests retrieval of an audio clip with specified parameters.

methods.name: uploadDataToUrl
methods.description: Uploads captured audio data to a specified URL via cURL.
